 Print Priscilla Chan says her 10-year-old daughter is vibe-coding, she has a desire to build things; but I did not allow her to make … Mark Zuckerberg and wife Priscilla Chan’s 10-year-old daughter Maxima is already exploring the world of technology, with a growing interest in building things using code. Priscilla Chan recently revealed that her eldest daughter has started “vibe-coding”, a way of creating software using AI tools and natural language prompts. However, the young tech enthusiast has one restriction at home: her mother does not allow her to build projects that are open to the internet. This includes a dating site that Max wanted to create, which Chan firmly turned down. “She’s quite limited, because Mom doesn’t let her build things that are open to the internet,” Chan told Colossus. “Like, she wanted to build a dating site. That was a no.” Priscilla Chan says her daughter has an innate desire to build things
 Priscilla Chan also spoke about her daughter’s natural interest in creating things, saying, “She just has a desire to build things that is innate, that we didn’t teach her. It just came. She’s delighted by the idea of bringing something into the world.” Max’s interest in technology is not entirely new. Mark Zuckerberg has previously spoken about teaching his daughters basic coding through Scratch, a platform that lets children create games, stories and animations using visual blocks. The Zuckerberg children have also explored tools and activities such as Replit, Google Docs, Kano, robots and 3D printing. Mark Zuckerberg has shared how he enjoys building robots with his daughters, with the family working on designs and using Raspberry Pi or Jetson hardware to run language models. Mark Zuckerberg’s younger daughter is also exploring technology
 The couple’s second daughter, August, has also shown an interest in coding and creative projects. She reportedly spends time working on Minecraft and Scratch projects. August also created a book titled The Mermaid Crystal, using Meta AI to help generate illustrations and a trailer for the project. Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have three daughters. Their approach to parenting includes introducing them to technology and encouraging them to explore creative ideas, while also setting boundaries around what they can build online.
